page_title: TOR 0-2 ROM | Torino v AS Roma 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: El Shaarawy S. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
90+1' Daniele Chiffi shows a yellow card to Nikola Vlasic (Torino), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
90' Che Adams (Torino) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
84' Saul Coco (Torino) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
80' Che Adams (Torino) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cyril Ngonge leaves the pitch and Alieu Njie (Torino) comes on.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Faustino Anjorin (Torino) is replacing Emirhan Ilkhan.
77' Substitution. Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) on for Devyne Rensch.
77' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Robinio Vaz (AS Roma) replaces Paulo Dybala.
76' The game has come to an end for Donyell Malen. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
75' What a huge chance for Donyell Malen (AS Roma). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
74' Referee Daniele Chiffi points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the AS Roma players.
73' Celebrations by AS Roma are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.

72' 0 - 2 Goal! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the roof of the net. Devyne Rensch assisted in the goal. 0:2.

72' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Alberto Paleari thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
67' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
62' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul.
61' The linesman signals that Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
59' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
55' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
52' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Pellegrini will be replaced by Matias Soule (AS Roma).
48' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) receives a quality pass inside the box and unleashes a first-time effort. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the goalkeeper.
46' The game is over for Gvidas Gineitis. Cesare Casadei (Torino) comes on for the second half.
46' The whistle blows and Daniele Chiffi starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' It's a weak, uncertain finish and easy for the goalkeeper. Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends in a volley from just outside the box that goes a few yards wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) is flagged for offside.
40' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
37' The resulting set piece from Torino is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
37' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Torino.
35' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
31' Zakaria Aboukhlal is being substituted because of an injury. Marco Baroni sends Marcus Pedersen (Torino) on the pitch.
30' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes a short corner kick.

29' The free kick from close range, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Torino will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Paulo Dybala sets up Donyell Malen (AS Roma) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
26' Cyril Ngonge (Torino) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Mile Svilar stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
25' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for AS Roma due to an offside in the build-up play.
24' Wait! Referee Daniele Chiffi has indicated he is going to review the AS Roma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
23' Fantastic team goal! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) was set free in the area by Paulo Dybala and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
22' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Mario Hermoso suffers an injury and Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) comes on.
22' What a chance for Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball went just wide of the right post.
21' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner with a short pass.

20' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. AS Roma will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
20' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
20' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
18' Handball by Donyell Malen (AS Roma).
17' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
16' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
13' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
11' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) displays brilliant awareness in the penalty box and sends in a first-time shot. He didn't hit the ball properly and it goes well wide of the left post.
9' Ardian Ismajli (Torino) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
6' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
5' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Daniele Chiffi was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
